crossRefs.note: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin…
For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings…
Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for…
Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for…

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.
translations.bsb: Lebanon is not sufficient for fuel, nor its animals enough for a burnt offering.
translations.kjv: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
translations.asv: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt-offering.
